column2: [intro]
I escape, I wander far away,
In my world, everything’s okay.
I create tales, I put on a show,
Reality’s too bland, too slow.
In my bubble, I soar so high,
Lost in my head, where I touch the sky.
I flee the real, I’m in my zone,
And I find it all so cool, I’m not alone!
I’ve got unicorns following me around,
Pandas dancing and monkeys who astound.
In my mind, it’s all a crazy spree,
Fantasy reigns with calm and glee.
In my bubble, I feel so right,
Where my dreams finally take flight.
I’m an artist, a true clown,
[ solo ]
In my bubble, I’m free and wacky,
I escape with no hold, feeling tacky.
Madness leads my steps, it’s my school,
In my bubble, I’m always cool!
[outro]
